A '''quarterstaff''' was a pole of varying lengths, commonly made of light alloys or wood.

==Description==
The quarterstaff was a simple [[Staff/Legends|staff]]-like melee weapon of ancient design made of [[Wood/Legends|wood]], [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]], or a [[Metal/Legends|metal]] alloy.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> It featured prominently in certain cultures and fighting styles, such as the [[Echani/Legends|Echani]]. The quarterstaff also featured in [[Stava (skill)|Stava]], a form of [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] developed by [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] assassins.

Other weapons were based on quarterstaff design, such as:
*[[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|Double-bladed lightsaber]]
*[[Double-bladed sword]]
*[[Electrostaff/Legends|Electrostaff]]
*[[Force pike/Legends|Force pike]]
*[[Handmaiden's staff]]
*[[Zhaboka/Legends|Zhaboka]]<ref name="Fad">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

==History==
Use of this weapon dates back to pre-historic times, well before the creation of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Force Adept]]s would commonly use quarterstaffs imbued with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] which were able to withstand lightsaber blows.<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Vodo-Siosk Baas]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], carried a his own personal Force-imbued [[Master Vodo's quarterstaff|quarterstaff]] which he used for physical support and combat. Quarterstaffs were also used by [[Jedi Weapon Master]]s.

The quarterstaff was possibly used by an amnesiac [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. He may have used it before getting his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and being retrained as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. It was also known to have been used by [[Valara Saar]].<ref name="MVS">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010517b_valara&c=rpg|text=Meet Valara Saar: Force Adept}}</ref>
